segments.name: Chartering
segments.description: Navios Partners charters its dry bulk, container and tanker vessels to charterers under time, bareboat and voyage charters and pooling arrangements.
segments.evidence: Navios Partners reports financial information and evaluates its operations primarily based on charter revenues, without differentiating by vessel type or the length of ship employment for its customers.

revenueModel.text: Charterers pay the company a specified daily hire rate under time and bareboat charters, agreed freight per ton under voyage charters, and allocated pool or profit-share amounts.
revenueModel.evidence: A time charter involves placing a vessel at the charterers' disposal for a period of time during which the charterer uses the vessel in return for the payment of a specified daily hire rate.
